RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000001: State your name and the facility from which you escaped.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000002: Man, name don’t even matter. Y’all already know where I was — Kentucky State, out near Rosewood.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000003: Life sentence. Caught a murder charge — first degree. No appeal, no parole, no damn hope.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000004: Then Day Six came, and everything flipped.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000005: Describe the condition of the prison prior to the incident.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000006: You ever sit in a box so long, the walls start talkin’ to you? That shit’ll eat you alive slow.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000007: Then outta nowhere — boom — it felt like Christmas came early.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000008: We started noticing somethin’ off ‘round Day Four.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000009: Folks coughin’, not regular sick — nah, this was deep. Wet. Like they lungs was tryna crawl out they chest.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000010: But who gives a fuck when inmates get sick, right?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000011: Then Day Five hit. Shit got wild.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000012: Some dude in C Block lost his damn mind — beat his cellie to death barehanded.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000013: Face looked like it went through a blender.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000014: At first, we thought it was just stress. Maybe some bad shit the guards were sneakin’ in.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000015: But then it happened again. Another body. Same mess.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000016: We ain’t stupid. We could feel it in the air.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000017: Guards stopped runnin’ their mouths. Got quiet. Real tight.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000018: No more transfers. No more movement. Doors stayed shut.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000019: Continue with the events of Day Six.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000020: Middle of the night — maybe 3 a.m. — I wake up to this bangin’.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000021: Not no regular knockin’. I mean full-body slammin’. Over and over.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000022: Metal screamin’, skin smackin’, bones crackin’.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000023: Cats was hittin’ they cell doors with everything they had — heads, shoulders, fists.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000024: Blood all over. Fingers broke. Bones pokin’ through.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000025: But they ain’t stop. Didn’t even feel it.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000026: They wasn’t mad. They was just... gone. Empty.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000027: Then we hear the alarms. Riot squad rushin’ in — black armor, masks, lookin’ like stormtroopers.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000028: One of ‘em shoutin’ somethin’ ‘bout a 'containment breach.'
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000029: But man... that shit was already done. It was over.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000030: Did the riot police open the cells?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000031: Not on purpose. But when folks started screamin’, one of them officers dropped his belt — keys, baton, radio — whole kit.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000032: Poor bastard. Think somethin’ ripped his throat out.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000033: Blood sprayed the wall like a damn art piece.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000034: I grabbed the keys. My cellmates ran one way — I dipped the other.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000035: I knew that prison better than I know my own damn face.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000037: Hell yeah. This wasn’t no group project. I saw an opening, I took it.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000039: I ran past at least a hundred fools — fightin’, screamin’, bitin’ each other like animals.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000040: Couldn’t tell who was infected, who was just pissed off. Didn’t matter.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000041: I seen one dude chewin’ on a CO’s face like it was fried chicken.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000042: Another had his brother pinned up, tryin’ to choke him out.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000043: Prison teach you one thing — don’t look too hard at anything. That came in real handy.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000044: Gunshots everywhere. At first it was quick bursts. Then longer. Then… silence.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000045: I slipped through the service tunnel by the dock. Found a back room, climbed up through the roof hatch.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000046: After that, it was just fences and timing.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000048: Yeah. Found some house, on the edge of town. Quiet. Empty.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000049: Snatched some clothes out the dryer, cleaned up, crashed on the couch.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000050: That was the best sleep I had in years. Even with the planes flyin’ low like the world was about to end for real.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000052: Fortunate? I was buried alive in that place. Waitin’ to die slow and quiet.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000053: Then the world goes to shit — and somehow, that’s what saved me?
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000054: Call it luck. Call it God. Call it whatever. Prison’s gone. Guards dead. Doors wide open.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000055: And for the first time in forever… I got a say in where I go next.
RM_d5fe3df0-5e3b-0146-0001-000000000057: Hold up… what you mean by that? You said y’all was lettin’ me go!
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000001: If you are watching this, it means that events have unfolded exactly as projected.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000002: Using decades of data modeling, socio-technological forecasting and collapse pattern analysis,
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000003: You are now one of the few individuals inducted into Project OASIS.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000004: As part of Project OASIS, you will need to come to terms with your situation underground,
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000005: And learn all the crucial systems of the Ark before going above ground.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000007: The Ark comes with many systems that ensure survivors will be comfortable and safe.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000008: Each Ark is built on top of an oligocene aquifer which provides unlimited water.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000009: And each Ark has two diesel Voltek GX-9 generators that will keep the lights on.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000010: And finally, the Circuair HE-3 ventilation system that will keep the air safe and warm, deep underground.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000011: All of these are controlled by a central computer, NOAH that will automate a great deal of your work.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000012: But these systems require maintenance, and as selected individuals who have been...
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000013: Inducted into Project Oasis, your specialized skills will become crucial in the days ahead.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000014: Generators require lubrication and coolant, and may need repairs.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000015: The water pump will require charcoal to filter the water to ensure potability.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000016: And the decontamination system required NBC tablets to ensure maximum safety.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000017: But first, take your first steps to read through the pamphlets the Department have left behind.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000018: These will outline in greater detail what you will need to do, and the steps...
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000019: You will need to take in the dark times ahead of you.
RM_d445445a-1a1a-0111-0001-000000000020: When in doubt, check NOAH for the latest situation within and without.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000001: TAPE 01: NUCLEAR EXPOSURE SURVIVAL - FEAT. DEAN PORCH
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000003: I'm Dean, and this tape is being recorded for the US Government.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000004: Now, I'm sure you've all been out in winter time, but let me tell you,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000005: Nuclear winter is so, so much worse.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000006: Now it's not all doomsday, you can survive out there.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000007: But you're going to need to be prepared.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000008: First off, the most important thing is your NBC suit.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000009: This is the Type C suit. It's a thick rubberized suit, lined with charcoal,
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000010: Combined with your gas mask will keep you safe and the bad stuff out.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000011: Before you get ready to go out into the winter wonderland, make sure you check your suit.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000012: And make sure you check your filters too! You won't have time to swap them.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000013: If you think you've come in contact with radiation, pop those potassium iodine pills.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000014: Another thing is going to be the cold, you'll want to stay warm. So layer up!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000015: Long john's, long sleeve shirts, button up shirts, every layer counts!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000016: If they give you Nikethamide, that'll help stave of the worst effects of hypothermia.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000017: And finally, make sure you thoroughly decontaminate afterwards.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000018: These decon tablets smell like strawberry, but don't drink or eat it!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000019: It'll make you sick or worse!
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000020: Remember, we're all in it together out there.
RM_d565951b-1b1b-0111-0001-000000000021: Keep your head on straight, and you'll come back alive.

RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-00000000000a: VHS: PROJECT OASIS, ENGINEERING INSTRUCTION SERIES, TAPE 01: GX-9 GENERATOR OPERATION
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000003: The Ark is powered by two GX-9 generators.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000004: One unit serves as the primary generator.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000005: The second unit acts as backup power.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000006: Generator systems are monitored by the NOAH central computer.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000007: Fuel levels and operational condition can be checked through NOAH terminals.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000008: Fuel is supplied through the external surface inlet system.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000009: Refueling operations should be performed carefully.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000015: Proper coolant levels reduce fuel consumption.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000016: Monitor generators for abnormal noise or smoke.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000018: Qualified personnel may repair generators using spare parts.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000019: Technical skill is required for advanced repairs.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000020: Do not operate heavily damaged systems.
RM_6cca967b-3893-410e-a5f4-000000000021: Loss of generator power may compromise Ark survival.
